CF.name: IRPP on income from movable capital, dividends (15 % of gross)
CF.statute: CGI 2017, official edition updated 2023 (DGID), art. 84 (LF 2025 OCR pp. 1-60 checked: art. 84 not amended; the rest of LF 2025 not read)
CF.doc: art. 84: the IRPP due on income from movable capital received by individuals is liquidated at 15 % of the gross income distributed; art. 116: withheld at source monthly by the payer.

CF.name: IRPP on income from movable capital, interest on claims, deposits and current accounts (15 %)
CF.doc: art. 49: income from claims, deposits, cash guarantees and current accounts is income from movable capital; art. 50: on the gross interest; art. 84: 15 %.

CF.name: Contribution foncière des propriétés bâties (15 % of rental value less 40 %, at least 30 000 F; main home exempt)
CF.doc: art. 170: base = rental value less 40 % for wear and upkeep; art. 177: 15 % for individuals and bodies not liable to IS (30 % for IS payers), at least 30 000 F; art. 169 12°: the first dwelling occupied as main residence by the owner or family is exempt (the household's home), other buildings taxed.
unsupported: rental value not below 12 % of market value or cost (art. 172)

CF.name: Contribution foncière des propriétés non bâties (27,5 % of 12 % of market value in urban centres)
CF.doc: art. 180 a): in urban centres the taxable income is 12 % of the market value; art. 184: rate 27,5 % — i.e. 3,3 % of the market value, applied in one step.
unsupported: rural land assessed per hectare (art. 180 b)
rounding to the nearest 10 F and the two-step rounding of 12 % then 27,5 %

CF.name: Droit d'enregistrement, mutations d'immeubles bâtis (7,5 %)
CF.doc: art. 77: sales of immovables are subject to the high rate (15 %, art. 301); art. 301 reduces it to 7,5 % for deeds and transfers of built immovables and to 6 % for urban unbuilt and rural built immovables.

CF.name: Droit d'enregistrement, mutations d'immeubles urbains non bâtis (6 %)
CF.doc: art. 301: 6 % for deeds and transfers of urban unbuilt immovables (land taken as urban).
unsupported: rural unbuilt land and concessions of State land at the 15 % rate of art. 77

CF.name: Droits de mutation à titre gratuit (successions, donations)
CF.why: art. 304 tariff per net share by degree; art. 306 shared abatement of 5 M F plus 3 M F per child or dependent ascendant across direct-line heirs and spouse, art. 308 reductions for children: the household input carries neither the number of children nor the shared abatement
